batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c CJ Anderson b SL Malinga

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b Z Khan

batting.name: Shakib Al Hasan
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b SL Malinga

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: st RV Uthappa b SP Narine

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b M Morkel

batting.name: CM Gautam
batting.dismissal: st RV Uthappa b PP Chawla

balls.text: in the slot on off stump and he has smeared it to the extra cover boundary. Made room outside leg and launched it and more importantly found the gap
goes for it again but this time the length just wasn't there. The keeper goes up in appeal and the bowler joins him very very late. Went off the thigh
more cheek from Yadav! This was full and outside off and he has reverse flicked it to the third man boundary! That is an astounding stroke!
walks at him and swings it away to the long leg boundary! Top shot from Yadav. Picked it up off a length and whipped it into the gap
walks across his stumps and drills the full delivery to long-off
he's gotten away with that. It was a length ball outside off and the batsman can only hit it as far as deep cover

caught at the edge of the circle at cover! Fuller delivery on off stump and Shakib tries to force the pace by shoveling it over the infield. The ball was too full to get under as well as he would have liked. Mumbai stringing some quiet and successful overs in the death here
low full toss on the pads, Pathan glances it down to long leg
yorker just outside off, Shakib digs it out into the off side
goes for the yorker outside off but this time he toes across the line a little
fullish on off stump, goes off the inside edge as he looks to thump it through midwicket

taken at long-off! Anderson, you beaty! This was full on middle and Kallis made a little room to blast it down the ground. Didn't get as much bat as he would have liked as the fielder rushes in and dives forward to pick up a neat, low catch! That was plucked inches off the ground. Asked the fielder if it was a clean catch, Anderson nods and off he walks
full and seeking the base of middle, Yusuf flicks it to deep square leg

safely taken! The knucke ball brings Mumbai back into the game. Uthappa was lured into playing an expansive drive on the up and he was an age too early into the shot. Gets a leading edge and perishes in quite a tame fashion
full and outside off, smeared away into the covers and Rohit dives to his right to keep it to a single. Had to tussle with an awkward bounce there
walks across to beat Malinga at short fine leg, but Zak slows it down and drags the length shorter to ensure his timing isn't up to the mark this time
picked it up and swats it over the deep midwicket boundary! It was length and he kept his front foot out of the way and muscled it.
walks across to push this fuller delivery down the ground
length ball outside off, Kallis flays it to deep cover

that stumps are in disarray again! Another Malinga yorker finds its mark. He was making room to try and open up the off side which made it all the more complicated for him to intervene with the ball's trajectory and off stump is knocked back
searing yorker fired in down the leg side and Pandey cannot get bat to it
low full toss that slides down leg and Pandey indicated he got wood on it but the ump turns him down. The keeper's dive isn't good enough and the ball dribbles away to the long leg boundary
the yorker on off stump, Pandey slams down an angled bat outside off to find point
goes fuller with that slower ball and he was expecting it this time. Stays still at the crease and whacks it over deep square leg
and he outwits the batsman straight away. Offcutter on leg stump, Pandey stayed beside it and swung across the line. Missed wildly

length ball carted away to the deep midwicket boundary! Terrible length to bowl and Kallis pounces on it as he clears his front leg and dismisses it. Strategic time-out again. Mumbai definitely need to gather themselves a bit here
slower length ball outside off, Kallis looks to slog over deep midwicket but gets a bottom edge to deep third man. Pollard can't believe it
back of a length delivery on middle, holds up on this slow deck and a leading edge falls safely past the bowler's reach on his right

walks around his crease and he has upset Pollard's rhythm wonderfully well. Moved outside leg first and lured him to angle the fuller ball in at him. And once that was done he quickly switched outside off and lap swept it to the long leg boundary
goes wide of the crease and presents a slower ball outside off, Pandey is out of his crease and pulls to deep mdiwicket
length ball and Pandey has pummeled this between long-on and deep midwicket. Clears his front leg and let the bat just swing freely
flighted on middle and Kallis swipes it over the midwicket boundary. Second six of the over and that raises Kallis' fifty. It's not his best innings but he seems to have found his form now
punched through the covers as this is a length ball fired in on off stump
that's more like it! Shimmies down the track to get under the ball and launches it into the crowd behind long-on
smacked through extra cover. Made room for himself, opened his shoulders up and thumped this length ball on middle to the boundary
goes down the track but Ojha pulls his length back and refuses any room. Pandey tries to pull it but gets a leading edge that lobs the bowler
tossed up outside off stump and he slogs it to deep midwicket. Ugly hack of a shot
full and wide outside off, looks to heave it over the covers but gets a leading edge that evades the fielder running back
slower ball outside off and Pandey is flummoxed by it. Goes for a slog-sweep and misses
dropped at short fine leg. Kallis was making big-time room outside leg and Pollard followed him with a full delivery speared in at his pads. He flicks it to Malinga who fells a sitter
good length ball outside off and Kallis goes for the booming drive through the covers but there is no timing on the shot
that's his fifty. Full delivery outside off smeared through point
back of a good length and just outside off stump, Pandey cannot beat cover.
back of a length and outside off, Pandey stays beside it and eases it through to deep point
fullish on middle, Kallis punches it down the ground
slower ball outside off stump, tapped away to point for a single
full and on the pads again, Kallis whips it to deep square leg
bouncer on middle and leg and Kallis has pulled it to the long leg boundary. Zak is the man there and he tumbled in an effort to try stop it but never looked like he was going to succeed
fires a low full toss on leg stump and Kallis goes for the flick a little too early. Leading edge back to the bowler
hoisted over the top. Got under it nicely and muscled it down the ground. Long-on can only usher it to the boundary
flighted on middle and leg, Kallis goes down on one-knee and sweeps to deep square leg
just a tad shortish and he goes deep in his crease to pull to deep midwikcet
sweeps to deep square leg as this was flighted outside leg stump. Moved his front leg away to make room for the swing of the bat
itches to get down the track and pick it off his legs through midwicket
flighted on leg stump, Kallis looks to flick it through midwicket but gets a bit of an edge back to the bowler
steered away towards point as he goes flatter and shorter
fires this length ball on middle and Pandey's attempt to dance down the track and loft him amounts to naught
gorgeous! Charges at him while making room outside leg and carves it over extra cover
goes down the track and eases this into the covers. Rohit is the man there and had he struck the stumps direct, Kallis would have been well out
clear evidence of Kallis being rusty. Goes for a sweep when the length did not permit it. Bounces a bit more and it takes his glove and almost hits his helmet
makes room outside leg and beats cover with a punch. Ojha darts a length ball at middle
takes a couple of steps down the pitch and dabs this length ball from off stump to deep point
flicks a good length ball off his knees to the left of Malinga at short fine leg
was setting up for the same shot but the length is a lot fuller and he has to adjust and steer it through the covers with an angled bat
flat-batted to the long-on boundary! Cleared his front leg and slammed the back of a length ball outside off stump
tapped to third man as the bowler tightens his line outside off
shortish and outside off, Pandey goes back and cuts to deep point
loopy delivery on middle, nudged down to long-on and that will be the strategic time-out
tapped away behind point
this time it's the conventional sweep and he picked the line wonderfully well. Saw it drifting into the pads and swung it dead square
well-flighted as he angles it into the leg side, but Kallis drags it behind point with another reverse sweep
flighted ball on middle, punched back to the bowler
the run-rate prompts Kallis to do something he's not at all known for. Manages an awkward looking reverse sweep and they take two as the quicker length ball goes off his gloves
fires this fuller delivery on middle as he sees the batsman charge at him, Kallis hurries into a push down the ground
picked away through midwicket as this was a length ball on middle, good hustle between the wickets
makes room outside leg but this flatter ball can only be squeezed out to point
saw the batsman charging at him and pulled his length back. Pandey blocks into the off side and Rohit rushes in from short cover to cut the angle. Isn't successful
skips down the track and he works to long-on for a single
stays firmly leg side of this nicely flighted delivery outside off and he smears it behind point. Didn't time it well enough
this is short and it allows Pandey to rock back and pull in between the long-on and deep midwicket regions. Muscled away.
goes for a heave across the line but this doesn't spin in at him as he had surmised. Looks terrible as the keeper collects it
swept away, but there is protection at deep square leg. Lunged forward and kept it all along the ground
loopy delivery on off stump and Kallis defends to the bowler
goes back as he sees this flatter on off stump and pushes towards mid-on
flighted on off stump, nudged to mid-on
flatter delivery on middle and Kallis can only push it to mid-off
goes back and dabs it behind point
comes down the track and gets hit on the front pad as he looked to flick around it
flighted just outside off, Pandey pushes back to the bowler
looks to whack it through the covers but doesn't reach the pitch and ends up mistiming it. Single taken though
skips down the track to ease this flighted ball outside off into the covers
shortish ball refusing him any room, Pandey is off his feet while clipping this through to deep midwicket
137kph, another one that is off the radar. Length ball sliding way across the off stump
slower offcutter, Kallis spotted it and gives some work for deep third man
back of a length on middle, Pandey tucks it into the midwicket region and they race across for a quick single
strays in line again as he goes for a length ball which goes down leg
think that was the offcutter and it seemed to have gripped into the pitch to square the batsman up. Pandey was waiting on the back foot and blocks it awkwardly
cuts behind point after shimmying down and meeting the shortish delivery with an angled blade
dabbed off the back foot to third man as Zak continues probing the off stump channel
good length ball going across him, Pandey makes some room and guides it to point
and that's the first six of the tournament this year. Soars straight over the bowler's head as he gets forward to the overpitched delivery and just extends the arms from a forward defensive
walks at him and though the bowler goes short he manages to thump it through midwicket. Not enough pace from Anderson to worry the batsman here

he's struck on the front pad and he seemed pretty adjacent too! But the ball might just have gone over the stumps. He was walking across and the bowler responded with a slower delivery just back of a length. Deceived the batsman as it darted back in at him and his guide to third man was nowhere close to it
good length ball going across him, Pandey taps it into the covers
goes for the blockhole wide of off stump, ends up a little off the mark but the batsman drags it to mid-on. Should have gone extra cover
good length ball tucking him up on leg stump, worked away to square leg
lovely timing! Stood up tall and punches this shortish ball through point. Rode the bounce and he found the gap to the left of the fielder there
rips a back of a length delivery right across Kallis. Well-managed in the end as he plays with soft hands and lets the outside edge run down to third man
walks at him and nudges to mid-on. Pollard was the man there but Pandey's momentum takes him home safely
the left-armer's angle lured an angled bat from Pandey. Pulled it back just in time to prevent the outside edge
looks to pick it off his knees but he doesn't connect. Zak rushes forward to control the ricochet off the pad
slower delivery kept right up there on off stump, Pandey is wise to it as he adjusts his stroke and pushes to mid-off
back of a length and on the off stump corridor, defended

what a yorker! Gambhir was so late on it and he throws a little look back at the stumps. That slingy action brought the ball back in at him and his jittery stay in the middle ends in the most emphatic fashion
low full toss seeking the base of off stump, Gambhir works it to midwikcet
nicely done by Gambhir. Realised the ball was defended with softly enough into the off side to sneak a quick single. Back of a length again with a bit of away movement
opens the face to dab this back of a length delivery behind point. Malinga manages some swing away from the bat as well
big shout for leg before as Gambhir plays a whip right across the line. But the umpire reckons there was a bit of inside edge. Lovely line from Zak again as this was full and tailing in at him
a little indiscipline fetches Kolkata's first runs as this length ball goes down leg
looks for the expansive drive as he saw the ball in his half, but Zak had brought this back in at him and Gambhir can only bunt it back to the bowler
good length ball on middle, cramps Gambhir up as he dead bats it
walks at the back of a length ball outside off and drops it towards second slip. Wanted the single, but Kallis coolly declines
play and miss as Gambhir is rooted to the crease while he looks to slash through point. Bite more bounce on offer as he hits the deck
hint of away swing away from the bat to start off and Gambhir strides forward to block
that's emphatic. Misreads the googly as he races down the track. Misses wildly and Uthappa breaks the stumps. Kolkata beat the defending champions by 41 runs, their biggest win over Mumbai
quicker and flatter delivery outside off, chopped to short third man
down the track and swings this flighted delivery down to long-on
well flighted outside off and he was looking to sweep it. Misses. They're checking the stumping but Gautman has dragged his back foot back just in time
comes down the track to get to the pitch of a flighted ball on off stump. Lovely drive over the off side
flighted on off stump, driven to long-off
switches his stance around in search of a reverse whip, but Narine is too clever for him. Fires in a yorker down the leg side and his premeditation means it's not a wide
moves across to the off side and slog sweeps it to the square leg boundary
good length ball which turns away from him. Goes back to try and read it off the deck and gets a leading edge back to the bowler
how much did that turn! Pitched on leg stump and turned right across the tail-ender's slog to disturb the off stump. A legspinner would be proud of that
flighted on off stump, Bhajji the new batsman looks to smear it to deep midwicket and gets a bottom edge

off stump is knocked back and Anderson's much awaited debut in the tournament ends up an anti-climax. Flighted on off stump and it turns back in. The slog over midwicket fails again and this time it signals the end of his innings
what's happened there? Uthappa has knocked the bail off with his gloves as Pollard's cut gets a bottom edge and wanders into the off side
fires it down the leg side. Good take from Uthappa. Moved with the ball and stayed low too
flighted on middle and leg, whipped away to deep midwicket
shortish and spins across him, pulls to long-on
flighted outside off, he goes down on one-knee to slog sweep it into the stands behind midwicket. Soundly beaten
he was into the pull shot way too early! Top spinner from Chawla and it held onto the pitch that much longer to sneak under his bat
starts off with the googly and it's too wide for him to cut
good length ball fired in on the pads, blocked
flighted outside off, eased into the midwicket region
think Uthappa's dropped it! This turns away from the left-hander, who swings seeking midwicket. Very thick bottom edge and it would have tested a regular keeper as well.
good length ball and it turns back in at him. Anderson was caught in front of all three stumps but there was a lit on inside edge
pushed through on off stump, Anderson chops it to point

he has it on the second time, Uthappa is seriously chuffed with that. This was the one that goes the other way and like the last time the batsman misread it. Keeper does though and in his excitement he missed the bails the first time, but Rayudu was so far down the track he has enough time to remedy his mistake
another ripper of a bouncer and Pollard looks in considerable discomfort as he tries to fend it away
he's broken his watch! Short ball angled in at his body and Pollard got into a perfect tangle. Strikes him on the wrist and the ball lands safely
146kph, Rayudu has decided he is going to shift across his stumps to to play Morkel. Drags a short ball from well outside off to deep square leg
148kph, walks across and he pulls it to the fine leg boundary. Uses all the pace on that delivery and finds a much needed boundary

143kph, off the bottom of the bat and his luck runs out this time. It was full and angled in at him. Rohit was looking to clear the midwicket boundary this time but Kallis had to make a bit of ground to his left and he overran it initially. But a timely little dive helps him hold it safely. Strategic time out now
smacked over deep square leg! That's a Rohit special! He was waiting for the back of a length delivery and pulled it comfortably into the crowd
Uthappa has missed the stumping there. Had not picked the ball turning in, nor did he stay low. Rayudu was deceived as well, racing down the track and swinging wildly.
neatly clipped into the vacant midwicket region
his use of feet turns a shortish ball into a length one which is belted to long-off
races down the pitch and slashes this down to long-off. No timing there
raps him on the pads as this is fullish and skids into him. Rayudu was slow with his flick and he was looking to play across the line as well
good length ball on middle and off, Rohit clips into the midwicket
tries it again, only off a fuller length and still Rayudu cannot get bat to it. This one sails over leg stump
walks across to the off side and the shortish ball goes down the leg side. The ump reckons its not a wide because of Rayudu's premeditation
Rohit was making room but the bowler follows him. Again hits the bat hard as Rohit runs it down to third man
uses his height extremely well as this thuds unto the splice of the bat. Also there is no room on offer. Only a single into the covers
138kph, runs at him but Morkel gets a little too much bounce to flat bat down the ground
138kph, shortish on off stump, opens the face and drops it behind point
and again! Shakib fires a quicker, fuller delivery well outside off after seeing him charge down the pitch. But Rayudu throws his bat at it and gets two to deep point
charges him again and though Shakib tried to fire it outside his reach, Rayudu manages to slice it to point
quick, length ball on the pads. Whipped to deep midwicket
slashes to the left of cover. He'd timed it extremely well but the substitute fielder down the there has equally well. Shakib applauds
that time his trip down the track ends up being detrimental as he yorks himself. Dug out to cover
excellent footwork from Rayudu! Reached the pitch, cleared his front hip and smears it to the extra cover boundary
another trek down the track but this time Chawla bowls it quicker and flatter. Pushed down to long-on
that is a pretty neat chip. Comes down the track and picked it away off his pads to the right of deep midwicket
short ball with enough room to cut to deep point
slows it up and loops it outside off, Rayudu sweeps it to deep midwicket. He was almost deceived in the flight there
opens up his stance and punches the shortish ball with a hint of room to long-off
flighted on middle and leg, stays back to block it
advances at him and turns a length ball into a half-volley which goes down to long-off
he made room to cut this short ball, but there is protection in the deep
back of a length on off stump, defended
lofted it over short fine leg. Walked across to the off side and lap swept it well over the lone man in the infield. It was the slower delivery but Rayudu struck it well enough
good length ball on middle, Rohit looks to whip it away again but there isn't enough pace on it this time
gorgeous flick and he's bisected deep midwicket and long-on
advances out of his crease and a little and drills this flighted ball into the cover field
round-arms a flatter delivery on leg stump and Rohit answers with an open face to pick up a single towards mid-off
flicked into the midwicket region and since the two men are right on the boundary the keeper himself has to run across and hunt the ball down
this was quicker and flatter, Rohit comes forward to block and gets an inside edge onto pad
flighted on middle and leg, flicked through square leg to raise Mumbai's fifty
fired in on leg stump, worked to the right of long-on
fullish on off stump, Rohit flicks into the midwicket region and that ushers the strategic time out
fullish on middle and off, driven down to long-on
short-armed jab and he finds the gap between deep midwicket and long-on. Cleared the infield comfortably and the ball seemed to gather pace off the turf
ducks back in off a fullish length, Rayudu was on the back foot and chops to point
shortish and angled in at him, whipped away calmly to deep midwicket
opens the face to ride this back of a length deliver outside off down to third man
good length ball on middle and off, punched into the off side

goes straight up in the air and Shakib himself takes the catch, albeit after a bit of a juggle. Deceived in flight as he charged down the pitch and swung across the line without getting to the pitch. Leading edge spells his doom
tossed up on middle and off, Tare drives strongly to short cover
nudged into the point region with an open blade and they swipe a quick single
comes down the track and pushes into the covers
stays on the back foot despite this being nicely flighted on off stump, chopped to deep point
slower ball and the batsman is kept to a defensive flick to mid-on
charges at him and drills one down the ground. Long-on is on hand to keep it to a couple
short ball on middle, eased behind square leg and the placement is good enough to fetch a couple. Well run
back of a length delivery, defended
pulled uppishly, but it bounces short of Morkel at the long leg boundary. Picked up the short ball on middle and leg and helped it along, but because of the slower pace the ball went up in the air
fullish and outside off, pushed down the ground to long-on
good length ball fired in on middle and leg, worked away in front of square leg
races down the track and whacks him down the ground. Shakib tried to send the flighted delivery well outside off to evade his reach, but he struck it wonderfully well
flighted on off stump, he pulls out the sweep through to deep midwikcet
nicely tossed up outside off, he waited on it and looks to slash it through the off side, But gets an inside edge to the keeper
flighted on middle and leg, worked away into the midwicket region
flighted outside off and Rayudu strides forward and pushes towards mid-off. Vinay swoops on it and underarms a throw which would have made for an interesting replay had it hit the stumps.
back of a length and just outside off, he goes back and punches into the off side

castled! Skids on after pitching and sneaks through his bat and pad. Huss' feet fail him once again as this one is pitched on a good length and deviates in at him. He looked all at sea trying to keep that out and by the time he played his shot the middle stump was knocked back
quicker ball on middle, pushed down to mid-on
swiped into the crowd behind square leg! This was drifting into the pads and he gets down on one-knee and slog swept it so powerfully
starts off with a shortish one on off stump and it's tapped to point
lets this good length ball angled across him go safely through to the keeper
no feet from the batsman as he looks to slap it through the covers. Morkel beats the outside edge again.
short ball on middle hurries onto him and Huss can't get it away. Struck on the body and the leg bye isn't on offer with the bowler rushing forward from his followthrough
backs away and slice the shortish ball away to deep third man. Had no intention of keeping it down
143kph, extra bounce, extra pace. Tare was slow on his rather ambitious back-foot punch. Well beaten
straightens off the deck as he pitches it just outside off and lures the batsman into poking outside off. PLay and miss
he was cramped for room and sort of pulls the short ball down to mid-on
manages to lob it over short cover. Stands up tall and essays a back-foot punch to a shortish ball outside off.
this time he connects and the length ball on middle is dispatched to the deep midwicket boundary. Hadn't middled it but he did hit the gap
back of a length and it's punched with a straight bat to mid-off
swings wildly and the bit of away swing on offer makes Tare look terrible as he looks to slog towards deep midwicket
shortish and outside off, Tare looks to force it through the off side but his timing is hampered by a little more bounce
this one hits the inner part of the bat now as he tries another drive, and the ball goes to mid on
tries to drive this one pitched up across him, but is beaten once more
left alone outside off on the angle across him
beaten, this time he prods at it, but it moves away slightly from a good length on the stumps to beat him
left from a good length, this is pitching right on the middle stump, but he is sure it will climb comfortably over the stumps
dabs a rising back of a length ball to third man
shout for leg-before as he is hit with this pitched up ball but the angle was easily taking it down leg
dug in short and he takes it on to hook it powerfully behind square
back of a length now, into the body, tucked in front of square
this one does not come in, carries across the left-hander on the angle, also moves away a tad beats a tentative push by some distance
coming in to the left-hander on the stumps, he goes back and defends
good length, hint of straightening, turned in front of square leg off the pad
